meta.name: edit-article
meta.description: Edit and improve articles by restructuring sections, improving clarity, and tightening prose. Use when user wants to edit, revise, or improve an article draft.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 润色文章结构、清晰度和措辞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要编辑或改进文章草稿
copy.tagline_en: Edit and improve article structure, clarity, and prose
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to edit or improve an article draft

howto.what: Claude 会帮你把文章按标题分成几段，调整顺序让逻辑更通顺，然后逐段重写，让每段更清晰、连贯，每段不超过240字。
howto.when: 当你要求编辑、修改或改进一篇文章草稿时触发。

say.text: 帮我编辑这篇文章，让它更清晰。
say.note: Claude 会先分段并确认结构。

say.text: 重写这段，让逻辑更连贯。

howto.what_en: Claude will split your article into sections by headings, reorder them for logical flow, then rewrite each section for clarity and coherence, with a max of 240 characters per paragraph.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to edit, revise, or improve an article draft.

say_en.text: Help me edit this article to make it clearer.
say_en.note: Claude will first split and confirm sections.

say_en.text: Rewrite this paragraph for better flow.
say_en.note: Claude will optimize the specified paragraph.
